title: Check yourself: max_tokens, stop sequences, stop_reason and usage

questions.stem: A nightly job asks for a JSON report and sometimes crashes in the JSON parser, with no error status from the API. Which first check does the page recommend?

options.text: Lower the sampling temperature so that the report is less variable from one night to the next
options.says: Ruled out because on current models "a non-default value of any of them is rejected with a 400 error", and variability is not what truncates a reply.

options.text: Read `stop_reason` and treat `max_tokens` as a cut reply before using the text
options.says: The page says "stop_reason indicates normal completion; HTTP errors indicate failures", so a cut reply arrives as a normal 200 and only `stop_reason` shows it.

options.text: Add a stop sequence at the end of every field that the report holds
options.says: Ruled out because a stop sequence is "a cheap way to end a reply at a delimiter you chose", which does not stop the reply being cut at the ceiling.

options.text: Catch the HTTP status of the call and retry every status above 399
options.says: Ruled out because a `max_tokens` cut carries a 200 status: "a `max_tokens` or a `refusal` arrives with status 200".

questions.stem: A team upgrades from an older model to Claude Sonnet 5.5 and every call returns a 400 until they delete a line that sets the sampling temperature to 0.2. What should they do about `top_p`, which they also set?

options.text: Replace it with `top_k`, which the model still accepts
options.says: Ruled out because "temperature, top_p and top_k used to be the knobs of randomness", and the page rejects all three, so `top_k` is no way out.

options.text: Keep it and raise it to 1.0, which is the safest setting
options.says: Ruled out because "the upgrade is a deletion, not a change of value", and the page does not name 1.0 or any value as safe.

options.text: Keep it, because only the temperature setting is rejected on that model and the others pass
options.says: Ruled out because "a non-default value of any of them is rejected with a 400 error", and the three are named together.

options.text: Omit it as well, since any non-default value is rejected for that release
options.says: The page says a non-default value of any of the three settings "is rejected with a 400 error" on the current models.

origin.section: Sampling settings you must not send
